senses.gloss:
Argala. — The word which is usual later to denote the
wooden pin of a door is found in the Śāṇkhāyana Āraṇyaka
(ii. 16) in the compound argaleṣīke to denote the pin and bar
of the door of a cow-pen. Cf. Iṣīkā.

Argala-Kāhoḍi is mentioned in the Kāṭhaka Samhitā (xxv. 7)
as a teacher. The name may, however, be Aryala, as suggested
in the St. Petersburg Dictionary, s.v., and as read by
v. Schroeder in his edition. The Kapiṣṭhala (xxxix. 5) has
Ayala. See below.
